profile_text:
Role: working parent of two kids (7 and 12), hospital nurse on rotating shifts.
Goals: stay on top of school, medical appointments and family logistics; never miss bills or forms.
Urgent: school closures or calls from the school nurse, pediatrician appointment changes, shift schedule changes, permission slips or forms due tomorrow.
Important: teacher messages, report cards, kids' activity schedules, family events.
Ignore: tech and AI newsletters, job alerts, startup and developer content, most promotions (grocery deals are fine).
Job targets: none.
Key senders: teachers, school office, pediatrician, partner, hospital scheduling.
